summary: Iteration 7 tested Live Course Sync, Course-to-Lab links and Recommended Course. Backend: 7 of 8 pytest tests pass. They cover the public catalogue shape (13 courses, urls, practice links, no _id), the cron route (401 with no or wrong Bearer, {ok:true} returned right away, synced_at changes about 2s later, duplicate X-Webhook-Id returns duplicate:true), auth on /courses/recommended (401 when logged out, student gets course + reason that match /me/analytics), and a failed sync keeping the last courses (SOURCE monkeypatched: returns False, 13 courses still active, meta.last_error set). One test fails: after a live sync, 5 courses have the wrong type. Frontend: the landing grid has 8 cards, /courses has 13 with synced-at text and working search, and the course dialog shows title, price, practice list and an Open course link (target _blank). Logged out, practice links go to /register. Logged in as student they go to /app/* and all 11 practice routes load. The dashboard recommended-course card renders and works. Course type filters give wrong counts because of the backend type bug.

critical.issue: type is taken from courseTags[0].text, but the store puts 'NEW' or 'FREE CONTENT' first for some courses. After a live sync, 715679, 715668, 585979 and 584863 get type 'New', and 711866 gets 'Free Content'. Result: /courses filter counts are wrong (Videos 4 instead of 7, Tests 3 instead of 5), those 5 cards drop out of the Videos/Tests filters, and the landing and /courses cards show duplicate badges ('NEW' + 'NEW', 'FREE CONTENT' + 'FREE CONTENT'). Fix: pick the first tag whose text is in {VIDEOS, TESTS, FILES}, e.g. next((t['text'].title() for t in c.get('courseTags') or [] if t.get('text','').upper() in ('VIDEOS','TESTS','FILES')), 'Videos').

minor.issue: If the student's only accuracy entry is 100%, the reason reads 'Your lowest-scoring skill is Brute Force at 100% accuracy.', which sounds odd. Consider other wording when accuracy is at or above 90. Also, matches are sorted by fewest topics, so Brute Force maps to JN0-104 (a Juniper networking exam) instead of the Kali or CEH courses, which is a weak match.

ui_bugs.issue: Wrong counts and duplicate NEW / FREE CONTENT badges, caused by the backend type bug above

action_items: Fix from_store() in routes_courses.py so type comes from the VIDEOS/TESTS/FILES tag, not courseTags[0]; then trigger a sync and check that /courses filters show Videos 7, Tests 5, Files 1
Optional: reword the recommendation reason when the lowest accuracy is high, and improve the topic-to-course match (Brute Force should prefer Kali or CEH over JN0-104)
critical_code_review_comments: ensure_courses only seeds when db.courses is empty. That is fine, but seeded courses have synced_at None and no meta.last_ok, so courses-synced-at stays hidden until the first good sync. This is acceptable.
Sync failure path is correct: it only writes meta.last_error and leaves courses active
recommended() imports analytics from routes_learn and calls it directly. It works, but it is coupled to that module.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all flows work; filters wrong because of the backend type bug)

seed_data_creation: Inserted cron_runs entries with TEST_ run_ids. The failure-path test set meta.course_sync.last_error, then a manual cron sync cleared it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_course_sync.py (asserts the type is one of Videos/Tests/Files). Cron secret is WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET in backend/.env with the quotes stripped. Playbook checks: bcrypt hashes start with $2b$, login sets access and refresh cookies, CORS sends an explicit origin with credentials. Lockout and seed_admin were not re-tested in this iteration.
